import pandas as pd
def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # remove exact duplicate rows (Order_ID duplicate)
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # keep only allowed categories (defensive)
    allowed_cat = ["Electronics", "Accessories", "Furniture", "Office Supplies"]
    df = df[df["Category"].isin(allowed_cat)]
    # Quantity must be >=1 (positive whole number) - removes negative -2 row
    df = df[pd.to_numeric(df["Quantity"], errors="coerce") >= 1]
    # Price must be >=0
    df = df[pd.to_numeric(df["Price"], errors="coerce") >= 0]
    # Region label variant (Nort -> North) does not affect Category/Price question, optionally fix:
    # df["Region"] = df["Region"].replace({"Nort": "North"})
    return df

def answer(df):
    # average unit price per Category
    df = df.copy()
    df["Price"] = pd.to_numeric(df["Price"], errors="coerce")
    # drop missing group keys
    df = df.dropna(subset=["Category"])
    grouped = df.groupby("Category")["Price"].mean()
    grouped = grouped.dropna()
    # return as {category: average_price}
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grouped.items()}
